kpr.title: KPR Simulator
kpr.price_tooltip: The selling price of the property you want to buy. Example: 800000000 for Rp800 million.
kpr.dp_tooltip: Down payment paid at the start of the purchase. Example: a Rp1 billion home with 20% DP means Rp200 million. The rest (principal) is financed by the bank.
kpr.interest_tooltip: The annual loan cost set by the bank. The higher it is, the bigger your monthly installment. Current KPR rates are generally 5-8% per year.
kpr.tenor_tooltip: Loan repayment period. A longer term means smaller monthly installments, but more total interest paid.
kpr.monthly_note: This is the estimated amount you pay the bank every month for {{tenor}} years (principal + interest). This figure may change following bank interest rate policies.
kpr.summary_tooltip: Summary of the total amount you must pay during the loan term, including interest.
kpr.min_income_note: Estimated minimum income so this installment fits the safe 30% of net salary rule.
kpr.within_limit: Installment is still within the ideal limit
kpr.cheaper_alt: or find a more affordable property
kpr.check_finance: Check financial capacity with Financial Profile

Hello, I would like to consult about a KPR loan with these details:

Property Price: {{price}}
Down Payment (DP): {{dp}} ({{dpPct}}%)
Loan Principal: {{principal}}
Interest: {{rate}}% per year
Tenor: {{tenor}} years

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Welcome to HuniOne. These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of the HuniOne platform and its services. By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms.
terms.s1_body: HuniOne provides an online marketplace connecting property buyers, sellers, tenants, and agents in Indonesia. You agree to use the platform only for lawful purposes and in a way that does not infringe the rights of others or restrict their use of the platform.
terms.s2_body: When you create an account, you are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You must provide accurate and up-to-date information at all times.
terms.s3_body: Property information is provided by sellers and agents. While we review listings, we do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of any listing. Buyers are encouraged to perform their own due diligence and verify property details before making any decision.
terms.s4_body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, HuniOne shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising out of or in connection with your use of the platform.
terms.s5_body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised date. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how HuniOne collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our platform.
privacy.s1_body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, and profile details, as well as information collected automatically, such as device and usage data.
privacy.s2_body: We use your information to operate and improve the platform, personalize your experience, send you property updates and newsletters if you subscribe, and provide customer support.
privacy.s3_body: We use cookies and similar technologies to analyze usage, remember preferences, and improve our services. You can control cookies through your browser settings.
privacy.s4_body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
privacy.s5_body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time. You may also unsubscribe from our newsletters at any time using the link provided in our emails.
privacy.s6_body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at officialhunione@gmail.com.
